Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀First who? 
Creative, you always have a new but appropriate solution to propose
Collaborative and open-minded
You hold a sense of responsibility and customer-oriented attitude
English and French speaker
 Our positions are hybrid, requiring 2-3 days per week in the Bucharest office. 
 🚀Then what? 
 We’re looking for a french-speaking DevOps Engineer to support the automation, deployment, and continuous improvement of application environments and delivery processes. You’ll work across infrastructure, CI/CD, containerization, and automation, helping teams build reliable, scalable, and secure solutions while improving operational efficiency.
 Responsibilities: 
Manage and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes
Automate recurring operational, infrastructure, and deployment tasks
Administer and maintain Kubernetes clusters and containerized environments
Provision, maintain, and optimize development and integration environments
Build and manage application delivery packages and deployments
Install, configure, and maintain DevOps and infrastructure tools
Troubleshoot and resolve environment, deployment, and operational issues
Contribute to improving system availability, stability, performance, and security
Create and maintain technical and operational documentation
Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to define and implement effective operational practices
Participate in Agile team activities and support developers in adopting DevOps best practices
 Tech stack: 
AWS / Azure / GCP
Kubernetes
Docker
Ansible
Terraform
Jenkins / GitLab
Git / GitHub
Linux
Python, Bash, Powershell scripting
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
